in_marathi.name: Mallik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mallik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mallik is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mallika’ which means 'lord of wealth'. In Hindu mythology, Mallik is an alternate name for Vishnu or Krishna, who is known to bestow wealth and prosperity upon his devotees.
